user_query: Identify the likely biological function of this protein from its sequence. Compare it with functionally characterized homologs and report sequence properties, conserved motifs, catalytic activity, cofactors, pathway, localization, oligomeric state, GO terms, and domain evidence. Distinguish curated evidence from homology-based inference.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.
